summary: Tested 3 changes end-to-end (backend pytest + Playwright at 390x844). (1) Triage fix: landlord 'Who's late?', 'What did I spend on repairs?' and 'Prefer Hank for plumbing' all get real answers. Off-topic 'pasta recipe' is still refused. Tenant prompts are also answered. Tapping the UI chip quick-reply-0 gave a real answer. (2) Report insights: POST /reports/{pid}/check returns headline, 4 insights, net, margin and note in about 6-15s, with valid tone/action/action_meta. In the UI: CTA -> Get insights -> headline + insight-0..3. invite_tenant goes to /property/{pid}. The add_expense sheet saved the expense, refreshed the report (Net $17,000 -> $15,766) and re-ran insights. (3) Plaid Sandbox: status shows configured with First Platypus Bank. link/start returns a hosted_link_url and link_token. link/status returns 'created'. Unknown token returns 404. Sandbox deposit -> sync imports it within one ~8s cycle. 'Maria Lopez rent' goes to review because Maria has already paid. Re-sync and 3 parallel syncs made no duplicates (unique index on bank_txns.id). Tenant gets 403. UI: the bank section shows 'Connected (First Platypus Bank (Plaid)) · synced ...', the sync and test-deposit buttons work, the plaid-sim-sheet deposit then Sync now shows the deposit in Needs review, and feed rows show 'Imported from bank · Plaid' / 'Matched to rent · Plaid'. Only failure: POST /plaid/sandbox/deposit with no amount returns 500 (KeyError).

minor.issue: body: dict has no validation. If 'amount' is missing you get a KeyError and a 500. A non-numeric amount also gives a 500. Use a Pydantic model (sender_name: str, amount: float > 0) so it returns 422.

After the first sync, every deposit that doesn't match goes to 'Needs review'. With Sandbox user_transactions_dynamic, each sync adds several 'Monthly payment ~$500' / 'Transfer From Checking' deposits. Needs review grew from about 11 to 21 items during testing. A real landlord bank also gets paychecks and transfers, so the list will fill with non-rent items. Suggestion: only put a deposit in review if it looks like rent (a tenant name is in the description, or the amount is close to a unit's rent/remaining). Otherwise mark it 'history'/'other'.
The webhook is unauthenticated: there is no Plaid-Verification JWT check. That's OK for Sandbox, but add verification before going to production.

Plaid txn dates are stored as {date}T12:00:00+00:00, which can be in the future. The UI ago() then shows 'just now' for every review row. Also, if auto_match raises HTTPException(409) in the middle of a sync, the sync stops before the cursor is saved (rare).

ui_bugs.issue: The StatusPill always says 'Simulated', even when a real Plaid bank is connected. Reference: app/(landlord)/money.tsx:74. Show 'Plaid Sandbox' when plaid.data.items.length is non-zero.

run() shows toast(`${r.imported} new deposit(s) imported`) and then immediately toast('Bank synced'), so the user only sees 'Bank synced' and never the imported count. Reference: app/(landlord)/money.tsx:82

issues: The review list is unbounded (no slice or 'show more'). With Plaid it grows to 20+ rows and pushes Expenses far down.
Each review row repeats the description twice ('Monthly payment · $543' / 'Monthly payment · just now') because memo == sender_name for Plaid. Hide the memo when it equals sender_name.

action_items: Add a Pydantic model to POST /api/plaid/sandbox/deposit so a missing or invalid amount returns 422, not 500.
Stop flooding 'Needs review' with unrelated Plaid deposits (only route rent-like deposits to review; mark the rest history/other). Add a cap or 'show more' to the review list.
money.tsx:74: change the 'Simulated' pill to show Plaid when connected via Plaid.
money.tsx:82: keep the imported-count toast (don't overwrite it with 'Bank synced').
Optional: verify Plaid webhook signatures before production. Hide the duplicated memo on review rows.
critical_code_review_comments: plaid_bank.py: the idempotency is solid (find_one check + unique index on bank_txns.id + claim via plaid_links.processed $addToSet).
plaid_bank.py link_status has no need(user,'landlord'), but the query is scoped by landlord_id so it's safe (returns 404).
agent.py triage is now seat-aware and fails open (in_scope true on parse errors). Off-topic refusal still works.
money.py report_check: uses the LLM with a rule-based fallback, action_meta is mapped from the rule candidates, and insights are capped at 4. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (chat quick reply, report insights + actions + expense sheet, Plaid bank section/sync/test deposit)

seed_data_creation: Added Plaid Sandbox deposits 'Maria Lopez rent' ($100-150) and 'Maria Lopez rent UI' ($77), both now in review. Created a Mortgage interest $1,234 expense through the UI test, then deleted it from Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login on web: localStorage rw_session_token=test-landlord-token. Both tenants are paid for 2026-10 (Tom was matched via a Plaid 'Tom Chen rent' deposit), so 'Who's late?' now correctly says no one is late. The test asserts that 'Tom' is mentioned. Run pytest with -n 0 for the agent tests (pytest.ini enables xdist). GET /money/bank returns {connected, bank_name, review[], feed[], tenants}. No DELETE expense endpoint exists.
rca_of_issue: 500 on sandbox/deposit: plaid_bank.py:164 reads body['amount'] from an untyped dict, which raises KeyError (seen in backend.err.log). The review flood comes from sync_item: after the first sync, unmatched deposits are left in 'review' by auto_match, and only the initial sync moves them to 'history'.
